summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of the sale of the Hyatt Regency Long Island (358 rooms) in Hauppauge, NY, on July 31, 2026, by its indirect subsidiary HH FP Portfolio LLC. The purchaser, ABGHLI2613 LLC and TIC Owner Hyatt LLC, paid approximately $26.5 million in cash, subject to pro-rations, with net proceeds of about $26.2 million. The company used about $25.7 million to repay mortgage debt secured by 15 hotels. Pro forma financials were filed as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for further hotel dispositions to reduce leverage.
